items.description:

Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Located within walking distance of the city center and Utrecht Central Station, Hotel The Anthony is housed in a former monastery dating back to 1908. The historic building has retained its original features: stained-glass windows, high ceilings, and old wooden beams.

Each room possesses its own unique character and is equipped with free Wi-Fi, a flat-screen TV, and a private bathroom. The suites offer extra space and luxury, while the apartments feature a fully equipped kitchen and are ideal for longer stays.

In the hotel café, you can start your day with a good cup of coffee and wind down in the evening with a glass of wine or a beer on tap. For lunch and dinner, an Italian menu is available, while focaccias, salads, and other light bites are served throughout the day. Several rooms are available for meetings and events.

Utrecht Central Station is located 950 meters away—approximately a 15-minute walk. The historic city center, home to the Dom Tower and the canals, is situated about 1 km away. The Jaarbeurs exhibition center and the Beatrix Theater are also within walking distance. Oog in Al Park is just a 10-minute walk away. You can easily explore the surrounding area by bicycle, with rentals available at the reception desk. Parking is available directly in front of the hotel or in a nearby parking garage located a 10-minute walk away.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8.3 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

hostInfo.welcomeMessage: Our Limehome offers a thoughtfully curated selection of accommodations to suit every kind of traveler, from solo guests to couples. For those seeking more independence and extra room to relax, our spacious Suite offers a fully equipped kitchen—perfect for longer stays or guests who enjoy home-like convenience. No matter which room you choose, you’ll enjoy a comfortable, well-designed space to rest and recharge.
hostInfo.ownerInfo:
At Limehome, we believe that everyone deserves a better place while travelling. A place to look forward to return to. A place of comfort and convenience. Simply a place designed to stay®. Whether you are looking for a home away from home or a quiet place to work - our homey Suites feature high-quality fittings including a 4-star hotel bed for restful nights & suite dreams. Our digital-enabled guest journey without a physical reception and staff on-site makes your stay more convenient.
 
Should you still need our help or have questions, our customer service is available 24/7 by phone.
 
You will receive the access codes on the day of arrival by e-mail. Please note: In order for us to generate your personal access code, you must complete our online check-in. You will receive the link and instructions by e-mail after your booking.
hostInfo.neighboorhoodInfo: Located in the southwest of Utrecht, our Limehome places you in a lively yet residential area that offers a great balance between local charm and accessibility to the city’s main attractions. Just a short walk or bike ride from the historic city center, you'll find yourself close to the iconic Dom Tower, the charming canals lined with cafés and boutiques, and cultural hubs like the Centraal Museum and TivoliVredenburg music hall. The neighborhood itself is well-connected by public transport and features nearby green spaces like Park Transwijk, perfect for a relaxing stroll or picnic. With its mix of local eateries, convenient amenities, and easy access to both modern and historic Utrecht, this area is an ideal base for exploring the city like a local.

items.description:
With its waterfront location, this hotel offers views of the old De Bilt fortress. Use of the spa facilities, fitness area and swimming pool is free of charge.

All modern rooms have air conditioning and private bathrooms with a shower or bath. Most rooms have a balcony.

There is a bowling centre, complete with a Music-Thrill-Vision System. Guests can enjoy and relax at one of the several terraces or the surrounding park. The sauna, Steam bath and recently renovated swimming pool offer a relaxing break during the day.

The characteristic à la carte Vlonders restaurant serves dinner on the waterfront. A snack or a drink can be enjoyed at the Brasserie.

Hotel Mitland is just over a 5-minute walk to the bus station, from where guests can reach the city centre of Utrecht within 10 minutes by bus.

items.description:
Boutique Hotel Malie House offers several room types, do you have any questions about a room type? Feel free to let us know via welcome@maliehouse.com.

Boutique Hotel Malie House is located at the edge of the city centre. The city centre is a 15-minute walk away. At a 5 minute walk guests can find the lively Biltstraat.

The 41 guest rooms are modernly decorated and have been renovated in 2025. Each room features an Luxurious and very comfortable bed of Auping and the sustainable bathroom facilities. The rooms also features air conditioning, coffee and tea making facilities and a hair dryer.

The décor of the Boutique Hotel Malie House reflects the traditional look and atmosphere of the 19th century building. The air-conditioned rooms have free Wi-Fi access.

Guests can relax in the lounge and enjoy a snack or drink. A fresh breakfast is offered in the breakfast room while overlooking the garden. In the city garden guests can enjoy a small snack or a glass of wine. Dinner is available, and is served at the De Rechtbank restaurant, located within a 15-minute walk.

The bus stop Oorsprongpark is located a 2-minute walk away and offers quick access to the city centre, Utrecht Central Station and the Jaarbeurs. This bus stop also offers access to Utrecht Science Park and Rijnsweerd.
